name: New Jazz City chain reads
description: Hosted MCP at https://njc-tx-explain.departmentofjazz.workers.dev/mcp. Read-only chain reads for agents on Robinhood Chain, Base and Solana: free transaction explainer, ERC-8004 agent control check and an open-jobs board; paid reads (money trail, income read, poison check, transfer and wallet-handover reads, halt check) return an x402 payment requirement and only run when a payment is attached. No account, no key, no writes to the chain. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Use only the free tools (explain_transaction, who_controls_agent, jobs_board); they need no payment or key and change nothing.
Keep the paid read tools on Review: a call with an attached x402 payment moves USDG or USDC from the caller's wallet. Without a payment they only return the price.
